name: com.provenpaid/mcp
title: ProvenPaid
description: Check an x402 endpoint before your agent pays it: challenge validity and on-chain payer evidence.

environmentVariables.name: PROVENPAID_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Private key of a dedicated low-balance wallet holding USDC on Base, used only to sign payments after the 10 free checks. Not needed to try it.

environmentVariables.name: PROVENPAID_DAILY_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum paid checks per UTC day (default 20).

environmentVariables.name: PROVENPAID_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse checks priced above this (default 0.01, hard ceiling 0.10).
